Purpose and exclusions

Authored configuration for Water casts, bobber, bite, reel and catch transaction. Runtime state never resides on this instance.

Never bypass the declared rule owner, mutate an authored definition at runtime, trust a client completion claim, or infer a compiled implementation from this page.

Creation and configuration

  1. Select DA_FishingPool_Rillmere in Content Browser; set DefinitionId to a stable domain ID, then set the fields in the linked feature contract.
  2. Assign this instance to the consuming native owner through its Blueprint child/defaults or catalog; a content file that is never assigned has no runtime effect.

Required sequence: create native prerequisites -> actual build -> child/data creation -> configure -> assign to listed consumer -> save -> run named fixture. A compiled shell without its consumer assignment is not feature completion.

Lifecycle and cleanup

  1. Author and validate stable definition/frame/field identity before use; load through declared references at readiness.
  2. Consumers may cache read-only references for their world/session lifetime; do not mutate the shared definition or place player quantities on it.
  3. On reimport/version change validate compatibility and migrate persistent IDs deliberately. Missing required rules fail closed; missing cosmetic layers use documented fallback.
  4. World/pawn teardown releases runtime references; persistent records retain IDs and versions only. Reconnect resolves the same definition without replaying grants.

Concrete player-to-authority flow

Participation in Water casts, bobber, bite, reel and catch transaction. Rule owner: URPGFishingComponent. This asset’s role is Authored configuration for Water casts, bobber, bite, reel and catch transaction. Runtime state never resides on this instance.

  1. Player equips/owns a FishingRod and aims from reachable shoreline. Server verifies water ID, pool, range, LOS, dry/shore policy and action state.
  2. Create one attempt and accepted cast point; replicate cosmetic cast/bobber state. p3 rod poses must match body/outfit pages after actual source inspection.
  3. Server chooses an auditable wait/bite schedule and opens the reaction window on its own clock; clients show cues using replicated accepted times.
  4. Player reels. Server validates the active attempt, current actor/session, one unused input sequence and receipt time within the allowed reaction policy; client claimed timestamps are not blindly trusted.
  5. On success select species from the approved biome pool and enabled weather/time modifiers, then atomically store terminal result, grant fish/profession XP and applicable rod durability cost with inventory capacity checks.
  6. UI/audio play from committed result and destroy the bobber. Late notifies/reel packets return AlreadyResolved and cannot grant fish.
  7. Disconnect/restart before terminal commit cancels unresolved attempt under lease-recovery policy; committed catch remains in inventory on reconnect. Never resume an old bite window into a new session.

Named fixture and acceptance

Fixture: L_Rillmere / Water_Rill / ShoreSpot_A / Bobber_A. Configure this asset at its first phase and run the linked phase recipe. Actual result: not run in Unreal/backend during documentation generation.

Stimulus / expected result
Reel before bite -> TooEarly under chosen fail-or-continue policy; no fish.
Late/replayed reel after Caught -> AlreadyResolved, unchanged inventory.
Full bag at terminal commit -> NoSpace, no fish or profession XP; attempt fails terminally rather than waiting indefinitely for a free slot.
Move/swim/unequip rod -> Canceled; bobber removed on all relevant clients.

Record expected/observed separately. Reopen the concrete map consumer; inspect authoritative state, stable IDs/revisions and UI. Static link checks cannot satisfy this gameplay test.

Common mistakes and staged limits

Do not put mutable stock, current health, inventory quantities or player quest progress on a shared Data Asset. A soft reference still needs validation and readiness.

Do not build later references as empty shells in an earlier phase. Source-derived art rows remain blocked by the missing ZIP; plugin API bindings remain blocked by installed-source verification. Placeholder visuals and proposed tuning are explicitly not production proof.
